newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian wool indicator falls 5c to 593c/kg.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian wool indicator falls 5c to 593c/kg.

text.p: The Australian wool market eastern indicator fell 5.0 cents to 593 cents a kg clean on Tuesday at sales in Goulburn and Melbourne, Wool International (WI) said.
Merino fleece was mainly cheaper, apart from 19 micron which rose by 0.5 percent.
The 20m indicator was 0.5 percent cheaper, 21/22/24m 1.5 percent cheaper and 23/25m 1.0 percent cheaper.
Merino skirtings of 19/20/21m were 1.0 percent cheaper.
In crossbreds, 26m was 0.5 percent cheaper, 27m 0.5 percent dearer, 28/29m unchanged and 30/31m 0.5 percent cheaper.
In cardings, lambs were firm, locks generally unchanged and crutchings unchanged, WI said.
WI said Japan and China were the principal buyers with good support from Taiwan and Western Europe.
Of the 25,770 bales offered, 5.3 percent were passed in.
Sales continue on Wednesday in Goulburn, Melbourne and Fremantle with about 43,000 bales on be offer.
